title: Metallica at Sphere: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Last-Minute Tickets Online
summary: The legendary heavy metal band's Life Burns Faster 24-concert residency in Las Vegas starts on Thursday, Oct. 1.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Metallica is coming to Sin City in October. After announcing an eight-show residency called Life Burns Faster at Sphere , the iconic metal band has added more dates , with 24 concerts in total, as of press time.

With a long list of Las Vegas residencies to choose from, the Sphere offers a visual experience unlike any other stage, and offers a state-of-the-art, multi-sensory experience that promises to bring the iconic metal band’s music to life in unique ways.

Shop Metallica at Sphere at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the residency first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute Metallica at Sphere tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Metallica Life Burns Faster 2026-2027 Residency at Sphere Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Metallica at Sphere Tickets at StubHub

find tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets in 2026.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. In addition, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, Metallica at Sphere tickets start at $755.

EARN REWARDS

Find Metallica at Sphere Tickets at Vivid Seats

FIND TICKETS at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert or your money back.

PROMO CODES

Find Metallica at Sphere Tickets at SeatGeek

FIND TICKETS at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap Metallica at Sphere tickets online from $721. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODE

Find Metallica at Sphere Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Metallica at Sphere concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $912, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find Metallica at Sphere Tickets at Gametime

find tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts like Metallica at Sphere start at $672. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket-buying experience.
